records.name: Putty Dance Project
records.summary: A husband and wife team, a dancer and a composer, who make new dance works about social issues, mixing live jazz, projections and jazz dance improvisation.
records.what_you_do: Come to a performance and stay for the open conversation with the artists afterward. Dance and music workshops are listed on the site when they are scheduled.

first_step.how: Watch the Upcoming Performances and Workshops section of their site, then use the contact page to ask about the next workshop or show.

records.notes: Site is up but shows no dated events or news ('No events found'), so status follows the rule for a working site with no dates. Cost, schedule and address not published. Fiscal sponsor is Fractured Atlas (donations only).

records.name: Queerobics West Philly
records.summary: A pop-up dance class and performance project led by queer and trans dance artists, disabled people and chronically ill community members. Low-impact and seated versions are offered.
records.what_you_do: Join a pop-up class in outdoor park and court settings, with dance captains offering low-impact and seated options. Masks are required.

cost.text: No class fee is listed. The site invites donations through its fundraising page.

schedule.text: Pop-up classes; the site does not publish a fixed weekly schedule

first_step.how: Register for the next class through the fundraising page linked from queerobics.com, or email queerobics@gmail.com with questions.

records.notes: Last dated item is a May 2026 outdoor class, taken from a video description on the site. The site also mentions a 2026 Season Kickoff and a 2026 Art and Culture Grantee designation, with no dates. Exact class locations and schedule are not published.

records.name: Realist Artists League
records.summary: An art studio in the Globe Dye Works building on Worth Street, focused on painting and drawing from life, with a figure and portrait focus.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for an open studio session to draw or paint from a live model, or take one of the studio's specialized classes.

schedule.text: Open studio with long pose figure and portrait: Saturdays 9 am to 4 pm, and Sundays long pose figure 9 am to 4 pm

first_step.how: Sign up through the Open Studio page on realistartleague.com before you come.

records.notes: Legal name is an LLC, but it runs open studio and classes open to artists, so it is published. Cost is not published (check the Open Studio page). The contact link on the site points to realistartleague@gmail.com while the displayed address is studio@realistartleague.com, so verify which one reaches the studio. Instagram handle is @realistartleague. The only 2026 date on the page is inside an image filename, not a published date, so status follows the rule for a working site with no dates.

records.name: Relâche
records.summary: A music ensemble that presents concerts and collaborative projects, and invites singers and players to join some performances.
records.what_you_do: Attend a listed concert, or sign up as a performer for a project such as the Unsilent Night event. Multi-week collaborative workshops are also listed.

first_step.how: Attend a listed concert such as Re UNITE on Sun Oct 25, 2026 at 4 pm, or email director@relache.org to ask about joining a performance.

records.notes: Status is active because the site lists concerts and workshops dated from Oct 2026 through Jun 2027. The site gives no posting dates, so last_sign_of_life is left out. Venue address and cost are not published. Interest is the closest tag for an ensemble that takes performers (community_band), since no contemporary new music tag exists. The 2027 Wildflower Lab entry has a date typo ('January-February, 2007'), so do not rely on that date. Instagram URL is built from the handle @relacheensemble shown on the site.

records.name: Revolution Shakespeare
records.summary: A Philadelphia company that puts on Shakespeare in new forms, including adaptations, readings and digital work, with a focus on how audiences hear and learn from the plays.
records.what_you_do: Join the mailing list for audition calls and show announcements, follow the readings and digital programs, or give a donation to support the company.

locations.label: Mailing address, c/o The Painted Bride Arts Center, Project Space

first_step.how: Sign up for the newsletter on revolutionshakespeare.org to hear about auditions and performances, and email revolutionshakespeare@gmail.com with questions about taking part.

records.notes: No dated events or news on the site. The footer shows a 2026 copyright (not evidence) and a '2026 Spring Fundraiser' page with no date. Status follows the rule for a working site with no dates. Schedule, cost and volunteer roles are not published. Check the Contact page for event dates. Interest is the closest tag (community_theater), since the company type is not stated.

records.name: Rock to the Future
records.summary: A free music program for young people in under-resourced parts of Philadelphia, run in schools, community centers and the juvenile justice system, with mentoring and college and career help.
records.what_you_do: Join a free music program such as Lyric Lab, a rap and songwriting class for teens that builds toward a live performance. Volunteers and donors can also help.

cost.text: Free. Food and transit passes are provided.

schedule.text: Lyric Lab meets Mondays, 4 to 6 pm

first_step.how: Register for Lyric Lab at rocktothefuture.org, or call or text 215-302-9633.

records.notes: Blog lists 'The Joy of Storytelling' dated 2026-10-02 (the article URL was not captured, so the homepage is cited). Mailing address is 1201 North 3rd St, #283, Philadelphia, PA 19122. Volunteer page exists at rocktothefuture.org/get-involved/volunteer/ but was not read. Serves more than 1,200 young people a year.

records.name: Rosenbach Museum & Library
records.summary: A museum and library at 2008 to 2010 Delancey Place that keeps rare books and manuscripts, open for study and for visits to its galleries and programs.
records.what_you_do: Visit the museum and its Treasures Gallery, join a course or public program, or ask about volunteering. Researchers can book appointments to study the collections.

schedule.text: Thursday to Saturday 10:30 am to 6 pm; Sunday 10:30 am to 4:30 pm. Closed Monday to Wednesday. Research appointment hours differ.

first_step.how: Visit during museum hours, or email info@rosenbach.org or call 215-732-1600 to ask about volunteering, courses or research visits.

records.notes: Latest dated item is a Rosenblog post, 'Notes from the Reading Room: Research with a Bite', dated 2026-09-29 (article URL not captured, homepage cited). Ticket and membership prices are not published on the page. Volunteer and membership pages are linked but were not read.
